contract.AQ: maxabs32 -> F32 reciprocal 127/amax -> RN32(A*reciprocal) -> roundf ties away -> separate F32 reciprocal 1/reciprocal -> D4 F32 store. This does not call/reuse MMVQ AQ.
contract.division_assumption: Existing fast_divide conditional CUDA published 2ULP envelope expanded to four F32 neighbours; observed source envelope, not universal CUDA formal guarantee.
contract.weight_decode: Only original independent qwen27 detail::weight(Q6_K) and F16 scalar decode reused; integer centered scale16 combinations exact below2^24.
contract.native_bound: G=K/32=16; H=K/64=8 (DP4A64 and TuringMMA128 subdots); B=K/256=2 nonempty stream-K partitions. At most 2G+2H+B+1=51 F32 product/add/fixup operations. gamma51 times outward absolute scaled group components plus separate activation code/scale ambiguity and independent F64 oracle bound.
contract.normal_domain: Actual A is zero or finite normal with abs in [2^-16,2^8], maxabs32 in [2^-8,2^8]; D4 scale interval constrained [2^-17,2^3]; original F16 d6 zero or abs in [2^-8,2^8]. All F32 intermediates lie on a grid at least2^-58 and sumabs<2^40; no FTZ/overflow in this stated domain.
contract.storage_discrimination: Before native submission, require at least one disjoint interval between correct D4 F32 d and intentionally wrong F16 d store with the same MMQ codes. Wrong store never becomes an accepted oracle.
